title: Editor E0 task 2: five render_path flags seeded false, a fail-closed reader and a switch on /admin/page-layout
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. Migration 20270346011400 seeds render_path_marketing, render_path_space_profile, render_path_spotlight, render_path_email and render_path_site false in platform_flags. lib/render-path.ts reads one surface fail-closed (a missing row, a read error or a non-true value mean the old path). The switch lives on /admin/page-layout (no menu row) and writes through setPlatformFlag, so every flip is audited in platform_flag_events. Why now: task 12b (the editor store on nids) and task 14 (native writers) cannot ship before a flag exists, since LIVE-875/877/887 refuse native writes today. Honest gap against EDITOR-E0 section 5.3: the reader is wired into the admin console only; its first real branch point is the task 14 writer switch, because the renderers are already byte-identical on both paths (LIVE-1001).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const m=fs.readFileSync('supabase/migrations/20270346011400_render_path_flags.sql','utf8');for(const s of ['marketing','space_profile','spotlight','email','site'])if(!m.includes(\"'render_path_\"+s+\"', false)\"))bad.push('unseeded '+s);const f=fs.readFileSync('lib/platform-flags.ts','utf8');if(!f.includes('renderPathEnabled')||!f.includes('data?.value === true'))bad.push('reader is not fail-closed');if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/page-layout/page.tsx','utf8').includes('renderPathEnabled'))bad.push('console does not read the flag');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1002: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a surface loses its seed row, the reader stops failing closed, or the console stops reading the flag. Behavior is lib/render-path.test.ts.
